Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

fly off the handle phrase

also lose one’s temper, lose your temper, flare up, blow up (in anger), see red

classical

Cic. Tusc. 4.19.43: nisi īrā excanduit fortitūdō (Lewis & Short)
Cael. in Cic. Fam. 8.12.2: id postquam rescīvit, excanduit (Lewis & Short)

excandēscō, excandēscere, excanduī

verb, third conjugation, inchoative, intransitive

flare up, blaze with anger

Other words

  • cito fervēre — boil up quickly

    also used · modern · Traupman 98: cito ferveō

    Traupman’s phrase; ferveō “to boil” is used of passions, but the phrase is not in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

See also anger, angry, be cross.
